The problem arises when multiple layers are set to the same opacity value, causing the top-most layer to appear opaque relative to other layers, while still allowing basemaps to show through. The report suggests that varying the opacity values slightly (e.g., 0.49, 0.50, 0.51) resolves the issue, indicating that the rendering logic may not handle identical opacity values correctly.

### Bug Analysis
